text: {"lessons":["I have repeatedly sold Stock D after gains, so I should decide in advance how to take profits without automatically cutting a position just because it has risen.","My average cost and the pain of selling at a loss can distort my choices; I should judge each holding by its prospects from today’s price, not by whether I can lock in a gain.","Before trading frequently, I should check how each trade affects my overall risk and diversification, and avoid acting on short-term price changes alone."]}
